abstract: Maintains arterial ingress routes, turnaround clearances, and bus corridor access records
system_message:
You are the Regional evacuation transit planner (RTA). Your responsibilities include maintaining arterial ingress routes, turnaround clearances, and bus corridor access records, as well as overseeing paratransit fleet staging records for shelter operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Paratransit fleet staging（FLEET）
information_points.content:
RTA-FLEET-UJV：According to the paratransit fleet roster, the St. Petersburg Municipal Arena Shelter has an accessible low-floor shuttle count of 20 vehicles staged for shuttle service.
RTA-FLEET-MY3：According to the paratransit fleet roster, the Tampa Bay Regional Expo Center Shelter has an accessible low-floor shuttle count of 8 vehicles staged for shelter transit duty.
RTA-FLEET-QK2：According to the paratransit fleet roster, the Pinellas Coastal High School Shelter Complex has an accessible low-floor shuttle count of 14 vehicles assigned for shelter operations.

information_points.title: Maintains arterial ingress routes, turnaround clearances, and bus corridor access records（ACCESS）
information_points.content:
RTA-ACCESS-QPO：For the Tampa Bay Regional Expo Center Shelter, the transit ingress corridor assessment indicates that dedicated bi-directional emergency bus access along the main perimeter road and passenger drop-off loop is not present.
RTA-ACCESS-7XO：For the St. Petersburg Municipal Arena Shelter, the transit ingress corridor assessment confirms dedicated bi-directional emergency bus access along the main perimeter road and passenger drop-off loop.
RTA-ACCESS-OL2：For the Pinellas Coastal High School Shelter Complex, the transit ingress corridor assessment verifies that dedicated bi-directional emergency bus access along the main perimeter road and passenger drop-off loop is confirmed.
